commit_message:
[Runtime][Python] Convert numpy.uint8 to ABI type i8 (#24524)

Benchmarks are currently failing because of "KeyError: dtype(uint8)"
these are fixed by simply converting numpy.uint8 to i8.

Also added other missing data types for numpy, i.e. `uint16` and
`uint32` and added a test case to ensure the benchmark argument creation
works for all cases

Signed-off-by: Florian Walbroel <walbroel@roofline.ai>
name: llama_8b_fp16/decode_benchmark_seq128_mi325.json
